title: Multi-line paste into a running program: the confirm dialog's accept key pastes, Esc denies, and no typed character is lost
why: QA chrome-parity-v2-1 (bug 3, low): the 'Paste into the terminal?' dialog opened with focus on Deny; Return did nothing, and typing 'seq 1 10' let the dialog eat 'seq' while the Space pressed Deny, so the paste and part of the next command were lost. cmux dialogs answer keys one way (CmuxDialogKeys): Return presses the default button, Escape the cancel one. A person confirms a dialog with Return.
source: independent QA bug (qa-chrome-parity-v2-1.json bugs[2]); repro: printf 'L1\nL2\n' | pbcopy, cat -n, Cmd+V, Return, then type

steps.title: awk reads the terminal (bracketed paste off, so a multi-line paste asks first)
Cmd+V asks first: the paste dialog shows
Return (the dialog keyboard's accept key) pastes both lines once and closes the dialog
a second multi-line paste asks again
Esc denies: the dialog closes and nothing is pasted
the line typed after the dialog arrives whole
